py=sorted(set(f for f in files if f.endswith('.py')))

assert tail==sorted(tail),tail

 original=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',ref+':full_stack_lab/tests/high_impact_check.py'],text=True,encoding='utf-8') if ref=='HEAD' else ''
